name: 雨のバス停
description: A shopping street on a rainy day. A woman in a cream coat is waiting at the bus stop under a blue umbrella. A girl without an umbrella is running toward the bus stop with her bag over her head. A red car is driving through a big puddle and splashing water onto the sidewalk. A boy in a yellow raincoat and green boots is jumping into a puddle. An old man is sitting on the bench in the bus shelter and reading a newspaper. A gray cat is sitting on the windowsill of the bakery, staying dry under the awning. There is a bakery with a red and white striped awning and bread in the window, a flower shop with a green awning and buckets of flowers in front, a red mailbox, and a street lamp.
